verdict.rationale: Warp is a payroll and HR platform, so syncing hourly time and overtime into payroll is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows hourly time entries or overtime feeding a payroll run. The pricing page lists only "Geo-fencing and shift scheduling," and the API mentions time-off data. Both are related features, not time-entry-to-payroll sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run
